input.quote: 9.8 Any Party shall have the right to review or audit the relevant books, records, vouchers, and accounts of costs pursuant to this Paragraph 9. In affording the right to review or audit, any such Party whose records are being reviewed or audited shall be permitted to recover, from the Party or Parties requesting the review or audit, the entire costs reasonably incurred in complying with the review or audit.
input.rationale: Paragraph 9.8 gives every Party (including the other APCN 2 Parties as against us) a right to review or audit our Segment S/T cost books and records with no limit on frequency and no notice requirement. Two of the three material fallback terms (once per year; 15 days' notice) are therefore absent, and unlimited/unannounced audits sit in walk-away territory. The cost allocation is better than preferred — the audited Party recovers its entire reasonable compliance costs from the requesting Party — and there is no system-access language, so those elements need no change. Paragraph 9.9's channelling of audits through the F&ASC is a procedural gate only and does not supply a frequency cap or notice period. The redline makes the minimal edit to reach the preferred position (once per 12 months, 30 days' prior written notice, business hours) while leaving the favourable cost allocation intact; the clause is mutual, so the same limits apply for our benefit.

proposal.summary: Cap audit frequency at once per 12 months and require 30 days' prior written notice under Paragraph 9.8.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a once-per-twelve-months limit and thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the Paragraph 9 review/audit right, which is currently unlimited in frequency and requires no notice. Our playbook position is one audit per 12 months on 30 days' notice during business hours; we are content to leave the existing cost allocation (requesting Party bears the compliance costs) unchanged, and can accept 15 days' notice if that works better for the F&ASC's procedures.

ops.oldText: Any Party shall have the right to review or audit the relevant books, records, vouchers, and accounts of costs pursuant to this Paragraph 9.
ops.newText: Any Party shall have the right, not more than once in any twelve (12) month period and on not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice, to review or audit during normal business hours the relevant books, records, vouchers, and accounts of costs pursuant to this Paragraph 9.
